area: Submission detail: header, location hero, GISA card canvas, notes, measurements/3D terrain

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Flexibility and efficiency of use / Aesthetic and minimalist design
heuristicIssues.issue: The checklist form is rendered on an absolutely positioned pixel canvas of fixed 520px-wide cards with mouse-only drag/resize. On any container narrower than ~545px (every phone) the right third of every card is clipped behind a horizontal scroll, and the layout tooling (Custom/Auto-fit pill, Tidy, Reset, Full screen, localStorage persistence) has nothing to do with filling in a GISA sheet.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/features/submissions/submissionLayoutModel.ts:69 (DASHBOARD_CARD_WIDTH = 520), :93-96 (columns = floor((w-12)/532)); web/src/features/submissions/useSubmissionDashboardLayout.ts:136 (effectiveWidth floor 344px), :275-279 (position:absolute, px width/height), :250-251 (mousemove/mouseup only); web/src/pages/SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:96,112-120 (onMouseDown handlers, aria-hidden handles), :762-794 (toolbar), :797 (overflow-x-auto container)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Replace the canvas with a responsive CSS grid of section cards (repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px,1fr)), auto heights). Keep the dashboard mode, if at all, only for pointer:fine devices with container >= 1076px.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Recognition rather than recall
heuristicIssues.issue: The decision inputs are far from the actions that consume them: the engineer's Submit comment is the last field of the Notes panel and the Reviewer Note sits in the bottom card grid, while Submit / Approve / Return for correction are in the page header. A reviewer can approve without ever seeing the note field; the placeholder even explains the disconnect.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/pages/SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:1280-1285 (submit comment, placeholder 'when you submit for review from the header'), :1301-1307 (reviewer note), :373,375 (submitNote/reviewNote consumed by header actions); web/src/features/submissions/SubmissionDetailHeader.tsx:126-142
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Open a small decision dialog from Submit / Approve / Return that contains the comment textarea and the confirm button; drop the bottom-of-page fields.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: User control and freedom / Visibility of system status
heuristicIssues.issue: Refresh calls load(), which rebuilds the draft from the server and silently discards unsaved edits; there is no dirty indicator, no beforeunload guard and no 'Saved' confirmation after Save draft. The only busy signal is the Refresh button relabelling to 'Working…'.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/pages/SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:262-330 (load overwrites draft state), :366 (saveDraft has no success feedback), :1182 (onRefresh={load}); web/src/features/submissions/SubmissionDetailHeader.tsx:124
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Track a dirty flag (draft !== loaded snapshot); confirm before Refresh when dirty; add beforeunload; show a transient 'Draft saved HH:MM' status next to the actions.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Error prevention / User control and freedom
heuristicIssues.issue: Completing any Sketch shape deletes every previously drawn geometry from the layer and immediately PATCHes the new geometry to the server; the removal happens outside the Sketch undo stack, so an accidental click with the polygon tool permanently replaces a carefully drawn area with no confirmation and no undo.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/components/SubmissionArcGisMap.tsx:224-232 (create -> remove all other graphics -> onGeometryChange), :199 (creationMode 'update'); web/src/pages/SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:399-424 (PATCH on every change)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Keep the previous graphic until the user confirms 'Replace existing geometry?', or support multi-geometry; make geometry part of the draft and save it with Save draft, with an explicit Undo.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Consistency and standards / Visibility of system status
heuristicIssues.issue: The hero builds a new `location` object on every render, and the map effect keyed on it clears and redraws all overlays and calls view.goTo(extent) each time. Because the page re-renders on every keystroke in any field, the 2D map snaps back to the content extent (and flickers its graphics) while the user is typing or has panned/zoomed elsewhere. The 3D scene explicitly guards against this pattern, so the 2D map is inconsistent with it.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/features/submissions/SubmissionLocationHero.tsx:96-99 (new object each render); web/src/components/SubmissionArcGisMap.tsx:293-299 (removeAll), :477-479 (goTo on every run), :489 (deps include location); contrast web/src/components/InteractiveTerrainScene.tsx:90-99,204-208 (anchorKey pattern)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: useMemo the location on the numeric lat/lon (or pass primitives), and only goTo when the coordinates or geometry actually change (compare a stable key). Verify in the browser: pan the map, then type in Observations.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Consistency and standards / Match between system and the real world
heuristicIssues.issue: Location facts are shown in three vocabularies: raw stored codes with tooltip apologies in the hero tiles ('2-digit district code', 'Caltrans county code', '3-digit route'), human labels ('District 3', county name) in the Report Header selects, and the compact descriptor in the h1. Worse, the hero shows STORED gisa values while the Report Header edits the DRAFT, so after changing the district the hero keeps the old code until Save draft with no explanation.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/features/submissions/SubmissionLocationHero.tsx:135-138 (gisa?.district etc. with title hints) vs web/src/pages/SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:811-858 (draft.district/county/route), :826 ('District N'), :845 (county name); :732-741 (descriptor)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Move District/County/Route/Post mile editing into the hero (single source: draft) with human labels, and delete the stored-value tiles.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors / Error prevention
heuristicIssues.screen: Header error banner + Material card + Notes panel
heuristicIssues.issue: All validation surfaces in a single banner under the header, far from the offending field: soil percentages must total 100% but are checked only when Submit is pressed; lat/lon, numeric and percent parsing errors are thrown from persistDraft; malformed Geometry JSON throws a raw 'Geometry JSON must be object'. Inputs have no inline validation and no aria-invalid.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/pages/SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:228-247 (soil check), :367-372 (only on submit), :335-338 (JSON parse), :1205 (single banner); web/src/features/submissions/submissionDetailModel.ts:96-116 (throwing parsers); vegetation min/max attributes exist only at :1092-1094
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Validate per field on blur with inline messages; show a live 'Total: 95% (5% short)' line under the soil inputs; keep the banner only for server errors and link it to the first invalid field.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Visibility of system status
heuristicIssues.issue: Invisible cross-panel dependency: the 'Open Highway Traffic Lanes' input appears in the Highway Status card only when the OPEN_HIGHWAY_TRAFFIC chip is selected among Immediate/Follow-up actions in the Notes panel, ~1500px lower; and the highway-status chips are hidden until a cause is typed, so a reviewer scanning the sheet cannot tell whether the status is empty or hidden.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/pages/SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:499 (openHighwayTrafficSelected from imm/fol), :1000-1004 (conditional input), :500-506,977-1010 (options hidden until cause), :1276-1277 (action chips)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Always show the status chips (disabled with helper text if a cause is required); show the lanes-open input whenever a lanes-closed status is chosen, or move the action chips next to Highway Status.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Consistency and standards
heuristicIssues.issue: Three persistence models coexist on one form: map sketches PATCH immediately, 'Sample terrain' POSTs and reloads the whole page immediately (from any role, including read-only viewers, because it renders outside the disabled fieldset), while every other field waits for Save draft. Users cannot predict what is saved.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/pages/SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:399-424 (geometry autosave), :332-364 (explicit save), :83-84,107 (tools slot outside fieldset); web/src/features/submissions/SubmissionMeasurementContext.tsx:39-53,67-74 (POST terrain-grid then onReload)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Pick one model. Either autosave everything with a visible 'Saving… / Saved' status, or make geometry and terrain sampling part of the draft; gate Sample terrain on canEdit and explain what it does.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Recognition rather than recall / Aesthetic and minimalist design
heuristicIssues.issue: The card titled 'Measurements' opens with a 460px 3D scene; the reference diagram and the eight inputs the card exists for sit ~700px down inside an internal scroll. The default card height (980px) is also the maximum card height, so the user cannot enlarge the card to see scene + diagram + inputs together.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Split: Measurements = diagram + inputs (auto height); 3D terrain becomes its own collapsed section ('Show 3D terrain') mounted on demand.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Consistency and standards (accessibility)
heuristicIssues.screen: All canvas cards + Notes action chips + header
heuristicIssues.issue: Most field labels are <label> without htmlFor/id, so inputs are unnamed for assistive tech; every toggle chip is a plain <button> whose selected state is colour-only (no aria-pressed, no glyph); the contact accordion uses '>'/'v' text with no aria-expanded; the '•••' button has aria-expanded but no menu role, Escape or outside-click dismissal; drag/resize handles are aria-hidden with no keyboard path.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/pages/SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:59 (label class), :802-870,1051-1054,1071-1078,1092-1094,1112-1114,1146-1153 (no htmlFor), :61-62 (chip/ynChip colour only), :984,1020,1039-1046,1063,1101,1107-1108,1121,1276-1277 (chips), :884-891 (accordion), :112-120 (aria-hidden handles); web/src/features/submissions/SubmissionDetailHeader.tsx:146-156
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Generate id/htmlFor from the field key; add aria-pressed and a check icon to chips; use aria-expanded on the accordion; implement the overflow as role=menu with Escape/outside-click; drop the drag handles or give them a keyboard 'Move up/down' equivalent.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Consistency and standards / Error prevention
heuristicIssues.issue: Report Date and Date Incident Reported are free-text inputs labelled '(YYYY-MM-DD)'; on phones this opens the full keyboard, and any format is accepted until the server rejects it.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Use type="date" (value already ISO) and drop the format hint from the label.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Aesthetic and minimalist design
heuristicIssues.issue: Eleven ArcGIS widgets (Home, Locate, Compass, ScaleBar, Search, Basemap gallery, Layers, Legend, Measurement, Coordinate conversion, Sketch) plus a custom 'Expand map' button on a 360px map; the custom button is absolutely positioned at right-2 top-2, exactly where the ArcGIS top-right Expand stack (Search/Basemap/Layers/Legend) is placed.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Default to Home, Locate, Sketch (when editable) and Expand; put Search/Basemap/Layers/Legend/Measure/Coordinates behind one 'Map tools' Expand; register the Expand button through view.ui.add so it never overlaps.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Match between system and the real world
heuristicIssues.issue: Raw identifiers and codes are shown to end users: 'owner user #N', 'Submission #N' as the scene label, the raw section_key (e.g. water_drainage) in the photo popup, raw ISO timestamps in Summary, and the descriptor is repeated in the h1, the header meta line and Summary.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Show owner display name; pass the descriptor as the scene label; map section_key through the section label table; format timestamps; show the descriptor once (h1).

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Error prevention / Visibility of system status
heuristicIssues.issue: GPS autofill calls the public ArcGIS geocoder directly from the browser and guesses the route from ANY 1-3 digit number in the address text, then silently overwrites county, district and route in the draft. On failure the only message is a generic banner even though lat/lon were already changed.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Only fill lat/lon; propose county/district/route as a dismissible suggestion ('Set to Sacramento / District 3 / 50?'); drop the bare-number route fallback.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Help and documentation
heuristicIssues.issue: Key explanations live only in title tooltips: the stored-value formats, why 'Show N/E' is disabled ('Select a county…'), the heading-count in the photo button, drag/resize hints, Tidy/Reset semantics. None are visible on touch or to screen readers.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Replace with visible helper text or aria-describedby; disable-with-reason pattern ('Show N/E — pick a county first').

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Visibility of system status / Aesthetic and minimalist design
heuristicIssues.issue: A qualityProfile 'high' SceneView is mounted for every visitor and role on page load, with two identical spinners (Suspense chunk + scene) and 9-10px control text plus 8px attribution; the sample-terrain button is 10px. Reviewers who only need the checklist pay the load cost.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Mount the scene on demand behind a 'Load 3D terrain' button with a static preview; raise control text to 11-12px with 32px targets; use qualityProfile 'medium' below lg.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Visibility of system status
heuristicIssues.issue: Read-only users (any role that reaches the page; APPROVED/SUBMITTED for engineers) see chips styled as buttons inside a disabled fieldset with only an opacity change, while layout tools, Sample terrain and map widgets remain active; nothing says 'read only' or why.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/pages/SubmissionDetailPage.tsx:108,725 (fieldset disabled), :762-794 (tools always shown), :83-84,107 (tools slot outside fieldset)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Show a read-only banner with the reason ('Submitted — awaiting review' / 'Your role can view only'), render values as text rather than disabled controls, hide layout tools.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: User control and freedom / Consistency and standards
heuristicIssues.issue: Delete uses window.confirm and a hard window.location redirect, breaking SPA navigation; the overflow menu closes on selection only.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Use the app's dialog primitive with the descriptor in the copy and navigate() after success.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Consistency and standards
heuristicIssues.issue: Three independent full-screen implementations (canvas fixed inset-0 z-40 role=dialog; 2D map fixed z-50 custom modal; 3D scene Fullscreen API + CSS fallback) each with its own Escape handler and body-overflow lock, and none traps or restores focus. The scene fallback (z-50) can open above the canvas dialog (z-40) that contains it.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: One Modal/Fullscreen primitive with focus trap, focus return, Escape and scroll lock; stack via a single z-index scale.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Aesthetic and minimalist design
heuristicIssues.issue: A raw Geometry JSON textarea (font-mono, placeholder '{"type":"Point",…}') is exposed to field users as a peer of the narrative notes, duplicating the map sketch; six narrative textareas are 2 rows tall for long-form geotechnical text.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Move Geometry JSON behind an 'Advanced' disclosure (read-only unless ADMIN); give narrative fields rows=5 with auto-grow.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Visibility of system status
heuristicIssues.issue: Photo evidence is fetched twice on load with two independent loading states ('Checking evidence…' in the header, 'Loading photo evidence…' in the hero) and the counts are shown three times (header pill, header button, hero legend).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Fetch once in the page and pass summary down; keep the header button label and the hero legend, drop the pill.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Match between system and the real world
heuristicIssues.issue: The Water/Drainage card mixes drainage condition (dictionary section K) with adjacent-impact assessment (section L); the Material card omits dictionary fields (material_pavement_type, boulder/debris percentages); the Distribution icon gets src='' (broken image) when a lookup code has no mapping.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Split into 'Drainage' and 'Adjacent impacts' cards; render the icon only when mapped; decide explicitly which dictionary fields the web form should expose.

responsiveIssues.issue: Every card is 520px wide inside a ~319px container (375 - 2x16 page padding - 2x12 section padding), so ~200px of each card (second input column, attachment button, chips) is clipped and only reachable by side-scrolling the canvas; the Full screen dialog has the same problem.
responsiveIssues.fix: Below lg (or container < 1076px) bypass the canvas entirely: render the same cards as a normal block flow (width:100%, height:auto, no absolute positioning) and hide the toolbar.

responsiveIssues.issue: Fixed pixel card heights with overflow-auto bodies create nested scroll regions (page > card > SceneView), which trap touch scrolling; Measurements (980px) is taller than a 768px-high tablet-landscape viewport.
responsiveIssues.fix: Auto card heights (no inner scroll) in the block-flow layout; cap the scene at min(460px, 55vh); on coarse pointers require a tap-to-interact overlay before the SceneView captures gestures.

responsiveIssues.issue: Photo evidence + Refresh + Save draft + Submit + ••• (or Return + Approve) wrap to 2-3 rows at 375px and push the form below the fold; all buttons are px-3 py-2 text-sm (~36px), below the 44px touch minimum.
responsiveIssues.fix: Below md: keep only the primary action in the header and move Save draft / Return / Delete into the ••• menu; or render a sticky bottom action bar; set min-h-11 on controls under @media (pointer: coarse).

responsiveIssues.issue: With the sidebar present, SUBMITTED + ADMIN shows six controls (Photo evidence, Refresh, Return, Approve, •••) and wraps under the status line at 768px.
responsiveIssues.fix: Same as phone: collapse secondary actions into the overflow menu below lg.

responsiveIssues.issue: 360px-tall map with eleven widgets on a ~343px-wide canvas; the custom Expand button at right-2 top-2 overlaps the ArcGIS top-right Expand stack, and Sketch/Measure/Coordinates crowd the bottom-right corner; the hero buttons are text-xs py-1.5 (~30px) and the Expand button px-2 py-1 (~26px).
responsiveIssues.fix: Below md load only Home, Locate and Sketch and register the Expand control via view.ui.add('top-right'); height = clamp(240px, 45vh, 360px); 44px min targets.

responsiveIssues.issue: grid-cols-2 at all widths gives ~150px tiles; values truncate with a title-only overflow that touch cannot reveal.
responsiveIssues.fix: Remove truncate and allow wrapping, or stack to one column below sm (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2). Preferably delete the tiles (see structural changes).

responsiveIssues.issue: Below lg the fields stack above the map, so at 768px the map is full width but still only 360px tall; the only way to get a useful map is the 66vh modal.
responsiveIssues.fix: Use md: for the two-column split and make map height responsive (e.g. md:h-[420px], lg:h-[480px]) via a CSS class instead of a fixed height prop.

responsiveIssues.issue: At 768-1024px the canvas is one 520px column with 180-450px dead space to the right; the Report Header cannot span two columns so its 300px height forces internal scrolling for District Contacts; the 'Drag a card by its header · resize from the edges' hint becomes visible at md (768px) on devices that have no mouse.
responsiveIssues.fix: Fluid columns (minmax(320px,1fr)) so one column fills the width; gate the hint and the drag/resize affordances on @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine).

responsiveIssues.issue: Drag and resize are mouse-only (onMouseDown/mousemove) with 6px-wide handles; on touch the cursor-grab header and the Tidy/Reset/Full screen tools do nothing useful.
responsiveIssues.fix: Remove drag/resize (structural change), or at minimum use Pointer Events and hide the handles/toolbar on coarse pointers.

responsiveIssues.issue: Two columns need a container >= 1076px; at 1440px with the app sidebar and page padding the container is roughly 1140px, so 110% browser zoom or a slightly wider sidebar drops the whole sheet to one 520px column with ~600px of dead space. The skyline flow with a 980px Measurements card also leaves a tall empty gap in the other column.
responsiveIssues.fix: Fluid grid columns; make the Measurements card short (move the scene out) so column heights balance.

responsiveIssues.issue: Scene controls are 9-10px text buttons (~20px tall), the attribution is 8px, and the right-hand control column sits in the clipped part of the 520px card at 375px.
responsiveIssues.fix: text-xs minimum, 32-44px targets, collapse the four overlay chips into one 'Layers' toggle below md; keep Full screen as the primary touch path.

responsiveIssues.issue: iPadOS Safari does not expose the Fullscreen API for arbitrary elements, so the CSS fallback (fixed inset-0 z-50 + body overflow:hidden) is used; body overflow locking is unreliable on iOS and the page behind can still rubber-band.
responsiveIssues.fix: Use the shared modal primitive with position:fixed body lock (or overscroll-behavior: contain on the scene) and a visible Close button >= 44px.

responsiveIssues.issue: Free-text date fields bring up the full keyboard; the auto-fit minmax(220px,1fr) grid becomes one column so the card's 300px height shows only ~3 fields before internal scrolling.
responsiveIssues.fix: type="date"; auto height in block flow.

responsiveIssues.issue: Layout works (single column) but action chips are px-2 py-1 text-xs (~26px) and 2-row textareas are cramped with the soft keyboard open.
responsiveIssues.fix: min-h-10 chips on coarse pointers; rows=4 with field-sizing:content / auto-grow.

responsiveIssues.issue: auto-fit minmax(320px,1fr) yields 3-4 very wide, 2-row textareas at 1440px; long narrative reads badly.
responsiveIssues.fix: Cap at two columns (max 2 x 1fr) or minmax(420px,1fr) and increase rows.

responsiveIssues.screen: Header overflow menu and hover affordances
responsiveIssues.issue: Hover-only cues: title tooltips on tiles/buttons, cursor-grab/resize cursors, hover:bg states; the ••• dropdown has no outside-click or Escape close, so on touch it stays open over the status line.
responsiveIssues.fix: Visible helper text; menu component with outside-click/Escape; no information in title attributes only.

One Modal/Fullscreen primitive (focus trap, focus return, Escape, scroll lock, single z-index scale) shared by the expanded 2D map, the 3D scene fallback and the section attachments dialog; delete the three bespoke implementations.
